metadata.title: PlatformKit — Production platform for AI-native SaaS in Go
metadata.description: PlatformKit is a runnable, domain-neutral Go foundation with tenant isolation, users, authentication, scoped API keys, audit, content, notifications, health, and an operator console.
metadata.keywords: platformkit, ai native saas, agentic saas, go saas framework, mcp server, ai agent runtime, modular platform, governed ai workflows

home.badge: For AI builders with real users
home.textTitle: Ship agentic products on a platform you can trust.
home.subtitle: Start from nine inspectable Go modules for tenancy, identity, scoped machine access, audit, content, notifications, health, and operator workflows. Add product domains in your own repository through one documented extension seam.

ui.experienceSectionsTitle: A small, explicit foundation for serious SaaS work.
ui.testimonialsSubtitle: The same contracts across products that need real workflows, tenants, and evidence.
ui.builderStatus: Describe the product that keeps returning.

sections.title: The demo is not the product.
sections.subtitle: The OSS starter supplies tenant isolation, users, authentication, scoped API keys, audit, content, notifications, health, and operator workflows. It leaves product domains and presentation to your application.

sections.title: Build once. Surface everywhere.
sections.subtitle: The starter owns one authenticated HTTP and operator surface. Downstream modules join the same database, identity perimeter, health graph, request limits, and OpenAPI discovery.

sections.title: Tools are product contracts.
sections.subtitle: Expose capability through declared module contracts and explicit scopes. Your application still owns authorization, validation, tenant isolation, and server-owned identity.

sections.title: Extend without weakening the perimeter.
sections.subtitle: The secure reference shows append-only migrations, declared machine scopes, route-level authorization, strict JSON, server-owned identity, tenant-scoped queries, and regression tests.

sections.title: Product decisions belong downstream.
sections.subtitle: Your product site, workflows, domain model, delivery providers, and end-user experience live in the application repository. The reusable OSS foundation stays generic.

sections.title: Replace parts without losing the system.
sections.subtitle: Module composition, migrations, identity, authorization, health, and release checks stay inspectable as downstream applications evolve.

commodities.title: One starter, explicit extension points
commodities.subtitle: Run the generic HTTP and operator surfaces, then add only the application-owned modules your product needs.

pricing.title: Start open. Add the production layer when the agent has users.
pricing.subtitle: Use the source to understand the contract. Buy the acceleration when you need templates, private modules, infrastructure blueprints, design-system depth, and implementation support.

footer.description: PlatformKit is a domain-neutral Go foundation for multi-tenant SaaS, with explicit contracts and one supported extension seam.

testimonials.name: Security boundary
testimonials.quote: Anonymous access, insufficient scopes, body-supplied identity, cross-tenant reads, and stale credentials are exercised as fail-closed cases.

testimonials.name: Extension path
testimonials.quote: A downstream module joins the same database, identity perimeter, health graph, request limits, and OpenAPI discovery without forking the starter.

testimonials.name: Upgrade path
testimonials.quote: Released tenant and user identifiers survive upgrades, while visible defaults and stale development credentials are remediated safely.
